claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Parker 從 OCP 目錄下架資料中心 UQD 產品，或 Parker 申報寫明退出資料中心液冷接頭。核查頻率：每半年（OCP 目錄重數）＋每年（Parker 10-K）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence 或提撤回，重讀快接頭層供給側。
claims.statement: Parker's OCP Marketplace listing (vendor-submitted, dated 2024-05-15): 'Parker’s Universal Quick Disconnect (UQD) is an OCP Inspired™ product based on the approved OCP UQD specification v1.0', quick disconnect couplers 'for liquid cooling and thermal management applications for servers and supercomputers'. OCP Inspired is vendor-attested conformance, not OCP certification and not NVIDIA qualification; no customer named (L8 weak).

source_doc.permission_basis: OCP 官方目錄上由廠商提交的產品頁；只保留研究必要的逐字摘錄。published_at 取 OCP WordPress REST（/wp-json/wp/v2/marketplace，id 1514）的 date 2024-05-15——上架發布日，不是擷取日。
source_doc.title: Parker UQD Series – Universal Quick Disconnect Couplings（OCP Marketplace 上架頁）

sources.quote: Quick disconnect, flat face couplers for liquid cooling and thermal management applications for servers and supercomputers. Parker’s Universal Quick Disconnect (UQD) is an OCP Inspired™ product based on the approved OCP UQD specification v1.0.
